question: Who among the following was the Governor-General from 1773 to 1785?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Warren Hastings.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Warren Hastings:-**

 
 
• He served as the Governor-General of Bengal from 1773 to 1785.
 
• Warren Hastings was the first Governor-General who played a significant role in establishing British rule in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Dalhousie:-**

 
 
• He was the Governor-General from 1848 to 1856 and was known for his policy of annexation and modernization.
 
 
 
• **William Bentinck:-**
 
 
• He was the Governor-General from 1828 to 1835 and is known for his social reforms such as banning Sati and promoting education. 
 
 
 
• **Lord Mountbatten:-**
 
 
• He was the last Governor-General of India who served from 1947 to 1948 and oversaw India's independence from British rule.
